scope: Read-only exact existing patch/receipt authentication and saved-source semantic audit. No full-model processing, array decoding, new selection, target generation, package/native import, GPU or Blender execution.

material_lineage.brick: Pinned selector recovered457original vertices/781faces; historical independent reader matched every original corner/position and all6material channels through later2343UV corners.
material_lineage.foliage: Historical independent reader matched source_vertex_ids[faces] to original_faces[source_face_ids], F32 position bytes, all6direct material rows and complete geometry/material coordinate order. Accepted F32 linearRGB remains source-linked.
material_lineage.displaced_target_vertices: Require genuine source-spatial eight-neighbour sampling, not original row-ID reuse.

brick.basis: Pinned original selector takes one original edge-connected component. Four UV islands are chart partitions, not a four-component surface claim.
brick.self_intersections: Not established. Historical projected UV overlap is not proof of physical3D intersection.
brick.surface_scope: Image/normal/depth/ROI selected sheet portion; no watertight-solid or closed-volume qualification.
brick.exact_edge_incidence_counts: Not found in reviewed existing patch receipts; not newly measured here.

foliage.surface_scope: Visible leaf/vine portions, not closed botanical parts. No intended-fragment or semantic segmentation claim.

inside_outside.final_neural_schema: Sparse I32 coordinates and F32[N,7]:3dual-vertex offset logits,3positive quad flags,1softplus split weight. No metric signed or unsigned distance channel is saved in this accepted conversion schema.
inside_outside.subdivision_logits: Strict positive BF16 logits choose8child support coordinates per parent, not a qualified continuous inside/outside classifier.
inside_outside.missing_support: Missing neighbours omit incomplete quads; sparse absence is not an authenticated exterior label.
inside_outside.conclusion: Do not treat triangle soup, quad flags or neural support as an SDF/watertight occupancy oracle. Nonvoxel open-surface methods may be assessed independently.

limitations: Fresh checks cover bounded patch artifacts/accepted patch GLBs/saved linearRGB and receipt/source text. Full original geometry/material payload hashes and source correspondence rely on historical independent evidence; original full arrays were not reprocessed.
This authenticates source inputs only. Installed method admission, new geometry quality and appearance transfer remain separately untested.
